name: RAMR
description: Retrieval-Augmented Memory Reliability -- contamination-resistant synthetic benchmark.

ramr_traces_v0.1.jsonl.note: superseded by v0.2; carries the kind label and generator order. Kept as the negative control that proves the v0.2 fixes work.

ramr_traces_v0.2_blind.jsonl.note: what a scorer consumes: no labels, order shuffled with seed 20260812.

ramr_traces_v0.2_labels.jsonl.note: ground truth for v0.2, keyed by chain_id.

ramr_traces_v0.3_blind.jsonl.note: v0.3 re-cut: stale value drawn as a SUBJECT of another retrievable fact, capitalisation matched, length balanced as far as the donor vocabulary allows. Shortcut floor 92.4% over 83.7% -- published, not claimed clean.

ramr_traces_v0.3_labels.jsonl.note: ground truth for v0.3, keyed by chain_id.

schema.question: str
schema.distractor_pool: list[str] (len 60, take first k for DISTRACTION)

contamination_note: entities are random synthetic tokens -> closed-book accuracy ~0 (uncontaminated).
hash_basis: sha256 of the file bytes as stored in git. .gitattributes pins *.jsonl and *.json to eol=lf so the working copy matches the blob on every platform -- this manifest previously carried one hash that matched no committed version of its file.
